description: Rescheduled for March 1st Due to Snowstorm Join us as we officially kick off Chester Tam’s campaign for State Representative in the 9th Bristol District. This event is an opportunity to meet Chester, hear why he’s running, and be part of a growing grassroots movement focused on transparency.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Chester Tam Committee to Elect
title: Campaign Kickoff Fundraiser | CHESTER TAM
